purpose: Prevent scope diffusion while preserving running products, accumulated IP and shared infrastructure.
north_star: Establish one repeatable revenue loop, then use AgentOS to reduce the human effort required to operate it.
intake: Register every new project, product, capability, content IP, experiment or material idea before implementation.
If it duplicates or extends an existing registry item, merge it into that item instead of creating parallel scope.
If it does not affect current BUILD or RUN operation, default to BACKLOG.
Promotion to BUILD requires an available BUILD slot plus explicit next gate and stop condition.

promotion_gate.build_question: Does this materially improve the probability of establishing or scaling the current revenue loop?
promotion_gate.support_question: Would not doing this block BUILD/RUN or force recurring manual intervention?

architecture_principle.statement: Products are compositions of reusable capabilities. A project/repository is a carrier, not the primary unit of reusable architecture.
intake_order: decompose requested outcome into domain-specific and shared capabilities
query the capability map/registry for existing semantic owners
reuse existing capability through adapter/composition when compatible
extend an existing capability only when the semantic owner remains the same
create a new capability only when no existing semantic owner fits without distortion
create product-specific implementation only for domain logic, composition, UI, policy or adapter concerns
anti_patterns: reimplementing auth, queueing, publishing, browser automation, matching, credits, analytics or other shared concerns inside each product
creating a repository before capability ownership is understood
treating a project name as proof that a new capability is required
generalizing a product-specific behavior into Core without evidence of cross-product reuse
